artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Thaddeus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with architectural elements and dynamic action. The image contains grand architectural structures with large, arched designs. In the center, there is a vertical column or monument. A group of figures is engaged in active motion around it. At the top center, a figure on a cloud emits light. Below, there is a chaotic scene with multiple figures involved in a confrontation, some holding staffs or spears. Various decorative elements and poses contribute to the dramatic narrative.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Matthew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with classical buildings. The drawing shows elaborate classical buildings with arched windows and doorways. Numerous figures are gathered in a large hall, engaged in various activities. Above the scene, a divine figure is portrayed seated on clouds, illuminated with radiant light. The composition is richly detailed, emphasizing the grandeur and intricate design of the buildings and the dynamic interaction among the figures. The style of the etching is reminiscent of works by early modern European artists who used linear perspectives and detailed engravings to convey narrative and architectural sophistication.

artworks.title: The Death of Judas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing a hanging figure. The artwork features a group of robed figures surrounding the hanging figure, with a building in the background and winged figures above. A large tree is depicted in the foreground. The drawing is done in a detailed, finely lined illustration style.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Barnabas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure rising towards the sky, surrounded by a crowd below. The central figure is enveloped by light and clouds. Below, several robed figures stand in a classical architectural setting with columns. In the foreground, individuals are in dynamic poses, some appearing distressed. The scene conveys a sense of divine intervention, using crosshatching for depth and texture. The composition suggests a moment of apotheosis or ascension.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in a crowded historical or mythological setting within an oval frame. A figure with a radiant aura is at the center of the scene, drawing the attention of others. The composition includes numerous onlookers, some seated and others standing on architectural platforms. Architectural elements like columns and a domed building are in the background. Overhead, clouds and a celestial figure are also depicted. The composition is detailed and dynamic, with a sense of movement and narrative quality.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.description: The image shows a city scene with detailed architectural setting and a high horizon. The cityscape includes a hill or small mountain in the distance. The artwork features intricate line work creating texture and depth, especially in the architecture and people. The color palette is mainly sepia or dark brown, giving an aged appearance. The scene includes numerous moving figures and buildings lining a narrowing street. An oval border surrounds the scene.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.8 × 10.2 cm (5 7/16 × 4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a bustling scene of a street with grand architectural structures. The buildings feature classical elements like columns and arches. The horizon is positioned higher in the image, framed by buildings on both sides, and hills and buildings are visible in the distance. The artwork shows detailed linework suggesting textures and forms with an engraving technique. The color scheme is monochromatic in brown and black hues, enhancing the historical and intricate feel. There is lively activity with people and horses in motion in the foreground, leading the eye towards calmer areas further into the cityscape.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view of a street lined with buildings on both sides. Towards the top of the image, a cloud of smoke or dust rises on the horizon. The etching work is detailed with precise lines characteristic of Jacques Callot's style. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and sepia tones. In the foreground, a crowd of figures fills the street, engaged in a tumultuous event that extends into the distance, framed by architecture on both sides.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 1]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.7 × 29.7 cm (8 9/16 × 11 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a collection of coin-like designs featuring various emblems and heraldic symbols arranged in a grid pattern. The medallions display intricate engravings of symbols such as crowns, shields, double-headed eagles, and human figures, often accompanied by inscriptions in Latin. Each pair of medallions is connected by an ornate design. The detailing within each medallion showcases textures and patterns rendered with skill, indicative of a meticulous engraving style. The overall layout and detailing suggest a study and representation of noble or royal insignia.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 2]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.7 × 22 cm (11 11/16 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows arranged rows of elaborate coin engravings featuring intricate designs, portraits, and heraldic elements. Each coin displays detailed and varied imagery, including crests, crowned eagles, lions, and busts of figures, each contained within circular borders. These motifs are representative of historical coinage and display diverse elements of heraldry, iconography, and inscriptions. The overall composition highlights the artistic precision and historical significance of currency design in earlier periods.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 3]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.7 × 20.8 cm (11 11/16 × 8 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The artwork shows a grid of circular emblems connected by ornate links. Each emblem features intricate designs representing heraldic imagery like lions, eagles, coats of arms, mythological figures, and inscriptions in classical languages. The emblems vary in design, indicating different institutions or authorities. The background is neutral, highlighting the seals' details.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 4]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.6 × 21.9 cm (11 5/8 × 8 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing shows a series of medallions and emblems arranged in an orderly fashion. Each circular medallion features intricate illustrations and lettering, connected in pairs by decorative designs. The medallions display unique symbols, inscriptions, crests, or portraits with historical or heraldic significance. They are systematically arranged to highlight the artistic detailing and craftsmanship of each item. The design style and use of classical imagery suggest a focus on historical or royal heraldry, while intricate border decorations and textual elements contribute to the stately appearance.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 5]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.6 × 21.8 cm (11 5/8 × 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a collection of twelve medallion-style engravings arranged in pairs, each pair connected by a small, ribbon-like design. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of black and white. The engravings showcase designs like heraldic shields, eagles, figures on horseback, and ornate floral or architectural motifs. Organized in four rows of three pairs each, the engravings exhibit intricate detailing in a grid-like pattern with ample space around each pair.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 6]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.7 × 22 cm (11 11/16 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a series of medallions and seals. The drawing features multiple rows of circular medallions or seals arranged in pairs connected by small decorative links. Each medallion contains intricate designs and inscriptions, including heraldic symbols, coats of arms, royal insignia, and human figures in regal attire. The entire composition is drawn in a precise and detailed style, reflecting careful attention to ornamental detail and text. The intricate designs suggest historical or symbolic significance associated with each medallion.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 7]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.6 × 21.8 cm (11 5/8 × 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of sixteen coins or medallions arranged in a grid. The image features intricately designed coins or medallions, each adorned with different symbolic and heraldic imagery, along with Latin inscriptions. Each medallion is positioned systematically in an orderly manner. The drawing gives a sense of regalia and historical significance. The detail suggests a focus on illustrating heraldic art and capturing the essence of different regions or sovereign entities. The artwork is likely detailed with consideration to historical accuracy and artistic finesse.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 8]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.8 × 22 cm (11 3/4 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of medallions or coins with intricate designs and portraits arranged in a grid-like pattern. Each medallion contains a detailed profile or design, with inscriptions or lettering around their borders. The drawings feature portraits in profile, symbolic figures, heraldic designs, and Latin inscriptions, each within a circular boundary. Some include shields or crests, suggestive of coats of arms or heraldry. The medallions are connected by small rectangles, implying they belong to a set or collection. The detailed detailing and arrangement suggest a meticulous study or catalog of historical or commemorative coins.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 9]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.6 × 21.7 cm (11 5/8 × 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing twelve pairs of circular designs reminiscent of medallions or coins. Each pair features intricate heraldic symbols, regal portraits, and inscriptions in Latin. The designs are linked by a small bridge possibly labeled with a lowercase 'R'. The imagery includes crowned eagles, crests, figures in period attire, shields with coats of arms, and various symbols associated with royalty or nobility. The illustrations are arranged in an orderly manner with a consistent style, indicating they may be part of a series or collection of historical or symbolic significance.

artworks.title: Coins [plate 10]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.6 × 22.3 cm (8 1/2 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an array of coins or medallions with various designs. The illustration consists of multiple rows and columns of round medallions, each featuring different symbolic or heraldic imagery. Each medallion is depicted in fine detail, containing intricate crests, religious figures, and Latin inscriptions. These medallions are connected and organized in rows. The style suggests precision and attention to detail, typical of engraving practices in print.

artworks.title: Mysteries of the Passion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.1 × 9.3 cm (4 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is composed of six oval frames featuring detailed scenes with multiple figures and architectural elements. The scenes appear to depict a narrative sequence with dynamic poses and expressive gestures. Some frames show grand architectural settings with columns and arches, while others depict open landscapes with foliage. The scenes vary from dramatic confrontations to gatherings. The intricate line work suggests an etching or engraving technique, with a focus on texture and detail.

artworks.title: Mysteries of the Passion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.7 × 7.7 cm (3 7/16 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of four circular panels, each depicting a different religious scene. The top left panel shows a divine apparition, the top right panel shows seated figures in an architectural setting, the bottom left panel shows an ascension scene, and the bottom right panel shows a crucifixion scene. The style indicates influence from religious iconography.

artworks.title: Mysteries of the Passion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.1 × 8.3 cm (3 9/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four circular vignettes depicting various scenes. The upper two scenes are set in richly adorned architectural interiors with large columns and arches, showing gatherings of people around tables. The bottom left scene showcases figures working with ladders in an outdoor setting. The bottom right scene portrays a figure ascending amidst clouds. The drawing features intricate detailing and ornate structures recalling Jacques Callot's style.

artworks.title: Mysteries of the Passion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.1 × 12 cm (3 9/16 × 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The drawing contains six oval miniatures, each depicting different scenes. The top row shows outdoor settings with architectural elements and groups of figures, while the bottom row includes indoor scenes and a cave setting with groups of figures engaged in activities.

artworks.title: Soldier with Feathered Hat
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 10 cm (5 7/8 × 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a confident pose. He has a mustache, pointed beard, curly hair, and wears an elaborate outfit with a feathered hat, ruffled collar, tunic, baggy trousers, tall boots, and spurs. In the background, there are several figures on horseback in a landscape scene.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Felt Hat, Bowing
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.2 × 10 cm (6 × 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a man walking to the right, shown in profile. He is holding a shield-like object in front of him with his left arm raised. The man has a pointed mustache, a small goatee, and long hair flowing down past his shoulders. He wears a long coat over a tunic and trousers with ribbon embellishments at the knees, as well as shoes with decorative rosettes. The background features rolling hills, trees, and structures implying a town or village. Various figures are engaged in activities like walking and riding a horse-drawn carriage, adding depth to the scene.
